summary: Tenaris S.A. filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, announcing a CEO succession. The Board appointed Gabriel Podskubka as CEO, replacing Paolo Rocca, who will continue as Chairman. Podskubka had served as COO since 2023 and joined Tenaris in 1995. The succession resulted from a long-term leadership planning process. No financial terms, advisor, or other deal mechanics are disclosed. This filing is a routine leadership change, not a special situation event. Watch for any subsequent strategic shifts under the new CEO; no risk-arb angle applies.
